title: Share an incident
description: Text reports, voice input, and transcript review are being developed. This preview does not collect or submit incidents.
nextDescription: You will be able to review and edit a transcript before choosing to submit a report.

describe.title: What happened?
describe.subtitle: Share what you experienced or saw. You can write in English, සිංහල, தமிழ், or a mix.
describe.placeholder: Describe the incident in your own words
describe.error: Please write at least {{min}} characters so we can understand what happened.
describe.transcriptBody: Voice transcripts can contain mistakes. Read and edit the text above before you continue.
describe.transcriptNeeded: Please confirm the transcript to continue.

voice.title: Voice input
voice.demoNote: Demo: no audio is recorded. A sample transcript is used until the speech service is connected.
voice.idle: Tap start, then describe what happened.
voice.error: We couldn't transcribe that. Try again, or type instead.

when.title: When and where?
when.subtitle: Approximate is fine, and both are optional.
when.whereHint: Only an approximate area is used, never your exact spot.
when.denied: Location permission is off. You can choose a district instead.
when.unavailable: We couldn't get your location. You can choose a district instead.
when.dateHint: Times use Sri Lanka time (UTC+05:30). A date needs a clock time; the server cannot store a date alone. If you only know a period, leave date and clock time blank. Nothing is inferred.
when.invalidTime: Enter a valid date and 24-hour time. A date needs a clock time. Choose either a clock time or a period, not both.

details.title: Anything else?
details.subtitle: Optional. Skip anything you're not sure about.

review.title: Review and submit
review.subtitle: Check your report before you send it.
review.privacy: Your description stays private. The public map only shows an approximate area and report counts.
review.errorBody: Your report is still on this device. Please try again.
review.invalid: Check the report description, date, time, location and application language.

submitted.title: Report received
submitted.subtitle: Thank you for sharing this.
submitted.next: Your report was saved. This confirmation does not indicate an AI analysis result.
submitted.empty: There is no report to show.

auth.title: Log in to report an incident
auth.body: Incident reports require an authenticated account. You can still explore the public safety map.

errors.unauthorized: Please log in again before submitting your report.
errors.forbidden: This account is not permitted to submit reports. Check your account verification or contact support.
errors.validation: Check the report description, date, time, location and application language.
errors.rateLimit: Too many requests. Wait before submitting again.
errors.uncertain: Submission could not be confirmed. It may already have been saved. Submitting again could create a duplicate.
errors.accountChanged: The account changed. Please review the report in your current account.
errors.generic: The report could not be submitted. Your draft is still available while you remain logged in.
